title: Wish
description: A non-binding (or culturally/religiously binding) wish — funeral, letter of wishes, care instructions, pet care, digital estate, distribution preferences

id.description: Unique identifier for this wish within the INHERIT document

wishType.description: The category of wish. Wishes may be non-binding in law but culturally or religiously obligatory
wishType.$comment: funeral: wishes about funeral arrangements — burial vs cremation, ceremony type, music, readings. letter: a letter of wishes to executors or family — guidance on how to exercise discretion. care: care instructions for a dependant (elderly parent, disabled family member). distribution: preferences about how specific items should be distributed informally. digital: instructions for digital accounts and online presence. pets: care arrangements for animals. general: any wish not covered by the other categories.

title.description: A short descriptive title for this wish

content.description: The full text content of the wish. May be lengthy for letters of wishes
examples: I wish to be cremated and my ashes scattered at Coniston Water
Please ensure my cat Mochi is rehomed with my sister Akiko
Burial in accordance with Islamic rites — contact Imam Hassan at the East London Mosque
Please ensure my dog is cared for by my nephew Tendai

bindingNature.description: The legal or moral force of this wish. Most wishes are non-binding but may carry significant cultural or religious weight
bindingNature.$comment: non_binding: carries no legal force — guidance only. culturally_obligatory: expected to be followed under cultural norms (e.g. African burial customs). religiously_obligatory: required under religious law (e.g. Islamic burial within 24 hours, Jewish tahara). legally_binding: enforceable by law in the relevant jurisdiction (rare for wishes — most are advisory).

addresseePersonId.description: Reference to the Person.id this wish is addressed to — typically an executor, guardian, or family member

addresseePersonIdDisplay.description: Human-readable display name for the referenced addressee person

relatedAssetId.description: Reference to an Asset.id this wish relates to (e.g. a pet, a digital account, a specific item)

examples: Written in consultation with Imam Hassan — follows Hanafi funeral practice
Updated after acquiring second dog in 2024

funeralArrangementType.$comment: burial: traditional burial in a cemetery. cremation: cremation with ashes scattered or kept. green_burial: environmentally friendly burial (no embalming, biodegradable coffin). sea_burial: burial at sea. sky_burial: Tibetan/Zoroastrian practice of excarnation. donation_to_science: body donated to medical research. other: any other arrangement.

funeralCeremonyType.$comment: religious: ceremony conducted by a religious officiant. secular: non-religious ceremony. hybrid: combination of religious and secular elements. none: no ceremony requested.

funeralCeremonyReligion.description: Religion or faith tradition for the ceremony, if funeralCeremonyType is 'religious' or 'hybrid'

funeralProviderOrganisationId.description: Reference to the Organisation.id of the preferred funeral provider

funeralProviderOrganisationIdDisplay.description: Human-readable display name for the referenced funeral provider organisation

funeralPrePaid.description: Whether a pre-paid funeral plan is in place

funeralPrePaidPolicyNumber.description: Policy number for the pre-paid funeral plan

funeralBudgetMaximum.description: Maximum budget for the funeral, in minor currency units

funeralBudgetSource.description: How the funeral is to be funded
funeralBudgetSource.$comment: estate: paid from the estate. pre_paid: covered by a pre-paid funeral plan. insurance: covered by a funeral insurance policy. family: funded by family members. other: other funding arrangement.

funeralLocationPreference.description: Preferred location for the funeral service or burial

funeralMusicWishes.description: Music requested for the funeral service
examples: Jerusalem, Abide With Me, and Time to Say Goodbye

funeralReadingWishes.description: Readings or poems requested for the funeral service
examples: Psalm 23, Do Not Stand at My Grave and Weep

coordinatingOrganisationIdDisplay.description: Human-readable display name for the referenced coordinating organisation

institutionOrganisationIdDisplay.description: Human-readable display name for the referenced institution organisation

likenessConsent.description: Whether the person consents to posthumous AI/digital recreation

likenessScope.description: What aspects of likeness are covered

likenessControllerPersonId.description: Who has authority over likeness decisions after death

likenessControllerPersonIdDisplay.description: Human-readable display name for the referenced likeness controller person

likenessTimeLimit.description: ISO 8601 duration — how long consent/prohibition lasts, e.g. P25Y = 25 years

likenessRevocationConditions.description: Conditions under which consent is revoked

syntheticMediaPolicy.description: Policy on AI-generated synthetic media using the person's likeness

likenessEnforcement.description: Tracking enforcement of likeness wishes — takedown requests and platform compliance

platform.description: Platform where enforcement action is directed

requestType.description: What type of enforcement action was requested

requestDate.description: When the enforcement request was made

requestedBy.description: Who made the request (executor, controller, legal representative)

requestedByPersonId.description: FK to person who made the request

requestedByPersonIdDisplay.description: Human-readable display name for the referenced requested by person

status.description: Current status of the enforcement request

referenceNumber.description: Platform's reference number for the request

legalBasis.description: Legal basis for the request, e.g. EU AI Act, NO FAKES Act, estate executor authority

existingDigitalModels.description: Inventory of existing AI/digital likeness models and instructions for each

action.description: Instruction for what to do with this model after death

controllerPersonId.description: Person.id who has authority over this specific model

controllerPersonIdDisplay.description: Human-readable display name for the referenced controller person

relatedTrustIds.description: Trust IDs this wish or letter of wishes applies to

provenance.description: Consolidated provenance metadata — how this entity was created, by whom, and whether a human has verified it
